message.text:
q10.

`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`

This is the full current schema applied when a SQLite database is uninitialized, rather than replaying the incremental version directories under `store/migration/sqlite/`. The migrator names the file explicitly and documents the behavior:

```42:56:/bench/repo/store/migrator.go
// - LATEST.sql: Full schema for new installations (faster than incremental migrations)
...
	LatestSchemaFileName = "LATEST.sql"
```

The project's contributor docs (`AGENTS.md` lines 20 and 108) confirm each driver keeps its own `LATEST.sql`, and `store/test/migrator_test.go` has a `TestFreshInstall` case verifying it applies cleanly to an empty database.
